main_text.p: 38 Et de tribu Gad, vrbem refugii homicidę, Ramoth in Gileath, & suburbana eius: & Mahanaim, & suburbana eius.
39 Hesbon, & suburbana eius: Iaazer, & suburbana eius: vrbes quatuor.
40 Omnes vrbes filiorum Merari per familias suas qui residui erant de familiis Leuitarum, vt fuit sors eorum, vrbes duodecim.
41 Omnes vrbes Leuitarum in medio possessionis filiorum Israel, vrbes quadraginta octo, & suburbana earū.
42 Fuerunt vrbes istę singulę, & suburbana earum per circuitum ipsarum: sic omnibus vrbibus istis.
43 Dedit itaque Iehoua Israeli vniuersam terrā de qua iurauerat se daturum eam patribus eorum: & possederunt eam, habitauerúntque in ea.
44 Requiem quoque dedit eis Iehoua in circuitu prorsus vt iurauerat

page.notes: Lower lines of the page are underlined in brown ink, a handwritten mark, not printed. The word "vrbes" in 41 and similar forms are as printed. Some words in the first line are partly faded.
